privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro_p: Tomodachi is a Japanese language-learning app currently in waitlist phase. This policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and the controls you have over it. It is written to be readable — if anything here is unclear, contact us and we will fix the wording.
privacy.who_p: Tomodachi is built and operated by Al Moutasem Hamdi as an independent project. The web app lives at https://al-mo3tasem.github.io/Tomodachi/ and is in pre-launch beta. For privacy questions, contact betterme@bytepluslife.com.
privacy.collect_intro_p: We collect the minimum needed to run the product. The categories below are exhaustive — nothing else is gathered.
privacy.collect_account_p: When you create an account, we store your email, a chosen username, and a display name. Your password is handled by Firebase Authentication and is never visible to us in any form.
privacy.collect_activity_p: As you use the app, we store game results — score, accuracy, mode, and timestamp — along with your in-app settings, such as theme and audio preference. We also keep a short-lived presence flag so the friend system can show when you are online.
privacy.collect_waitlist_p: If you join the pre-launch waitlist, we store the email address you submit. That is the entire record. You can unsubscribe any time using the link at the bottom of any waitlist email.
privacy.collect_technical_p: Our hosting provider receives standard request data — IP address, browser type, and referring page — as part of serving the site. This data is held briefly for security and abuse prevention. We do not use it to build a profile of you.
privacy.use_intro_p: Each category above maps to a specific purpose:
privacy.use_li_run: Run the app — sign you in, save your progress, restore it on your next visit.
privacy.use_li_sync: Sync game results across the devices you use to sign in.
privacy.use_li_multiplayer: Power multiplayer — show your display name and presence to the friend you duel or co-op with.
privacy.use_li_improve: Improve the product through aggregated analytics, only if you accept analytics cookies.
privacy.use_li_announce: Send the occasional launch update if you joined the waitlist. Nothing else.
privacy.third_intro_p: Tomodachi relies on the following providers. Each one processes a specific slice of data for a specific reason.
privacy.third_firebase_p: Firebase handles authentication, our database, and parts of our hosting. Your account record and game results live in Firestore, replicated across Google Cloud regions. Firebase is governed by Google's privacy policy.
privacy.third_brevo_p: Brevo, formerly Sendinblue, holds the waitlist email list and sends the confirmation and launch emails. Your email stays in Brevo until you unsubscribe or the waitlist closes.
privacy.third_ga_p: Google Analytics measures aggregate usage of the landing page and app. It loads only after you accept analytics cookies. IP addresses are anonymized where supported. We do not link analytics data to your account.
privacy.third_sentry_p: Sentry captures error reports if something crashes. It loads only after you accept error-monitoring cookies. Reports include the stack trace and, if you are signed in, your username — never your password and never the content of your input fields.
privacy.cookies_p: Tomodachi uses a small set of essential cookies and browser storage for sign-in and preferences. Optional analytics and error-monitoring cookies are loaded only with your consent. The Cookie Policy, linked from the homepage footer, lists every cookie by name.
privacy.rights_intro_p: Regardless of where you live, you have the following controls over your data. We honor these globally.
privacy.rights_li_access: Access — request a copy of the data we hold about you.
privacy.rights_li_correct: Correct — fix anything inaccurate from your Profile settings, or by email if Profile cannot reach it.
privacy.rights_li_delete: Delete — remove your account from Settings. This wipes your account record, game history, and presence data within 30 days.
privacy.rights_li_withdraw: Withdraw consent — change cookie preferences any time using the Cookie Settings link in the footer.
privacy.rights_li_portability: Portability — request your data in a portable JSON export by email.
privacy.retain_intro_p: Retention is bounded — nothing is kept indefinitely:
privacy.retain_li_account: Account record — kept while your account exists, removed within 30 days of deletion.
privacy.retain_li_results: Game results — same lifecycle as your account.
privacy.retain_li_waitlist: Waitlist email — kept until you unsubscribe or the waitlist closes.
privacy.retain_li_errors: Error reports — 90 days, then automatically purged from Sentry.
privacy.retain_li_analytics: Analytics — 14 months, the default for Google Analytics 4.
privacy.children_p: Tomodachi is not directed to users under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has created an account, contact us and we will remove the data.
privacy.international_p: Tomodachi runs on Google Cloud infrastructure, which means data may be processed in the United States and the European Union. By using Tomodachi you consent to that processing. Users in the European Union have rights under the GDPR; we honor those rights for everyone, not only EU residents.
privacy.changes_p: When this policy changes, we update the date at the top. Material changes are highlighted on the homepage for 30 days, and waitlist members receive a short email summary.
privacy.contact_p: Questions about privacy, a data request, or a concern — reach us at betterme@bytepluslife.com. We aim to reply within seven days.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro_p: These terms cover what you can expect from Tomodachi and what we expect from you. They are written to be readable. If a clause is unclear, contact us and we will rephrase it.
terms.acceptance_p: By creating an account or joining the waitlist, you agree to these terms and to our Privacy Policy, linked from the homepage footer. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.what_p: Tomodachi is a web app for learning Japanese, bilingual in English and Arabic, currently in waitlist and closed-beta phase. The free tier will remain substantial after launch. A Pro tier will follow with paid features — pricing is not final, and you will see it before being asked to pay.
terms.eligibility_p: You must be at least 13 years old to create an account. If you are under 18, you confirm that a parent or guardian has approved your use. Tomodachi is not designed for younger children.
terms.account_p: Keep your password private and use a strong one. You are responsible for everything that happens under your account. If you suspect someone else has signed in, change your password and email betterme@bytepluslife.com so we can help.
terms.acceptable_intro_p: A short list of what is not allowed:
terms.acceptable_li_illegal: Using Tomodachi for anything illegal where you live or where the service is hosted.
terms.acceptable_li_harass: Harassing other learners through display names, chat features once they ship, or duel and co-op interactions.
terms.acceptable_li_break: Probing, scraping, or reverse-engineering the app, except to the extent the law expressly permits.
terms.acceptable_li_bots: Using bots, scripts, or automation to play games or inflate scores.
terms.acceptable_li_impersonate: Impersonating other people, brands, or Tomodachi staff.
terms.acceptable_li_multi: Creating multiple accounts to manipulate leaderboards or evade a ban.
terms.content_p: Tomodachi's lessons, vocabulary cards, mnemonics, grammar explanations, and audio are owned by us and licensed to you for personal learning. You may not copy or redistribute the content, train other models on it, or use it in a competing product.
terms.beta_p: Tomodachi is in pre-launch beta. Features and data shapes may change. We may pause accounts, reset test data, or migrate between Firebase projects during this period. When that affects you, we will email the address on file first.
terms.termination_p: You can delete your account from Settings at any time. We may suspend or close an account that violates these terms, after warning where reasonable, or immediately when the violation is severe — for example, illegal use.
terms.disclaimers_p: Tomodachi is provided as-is during beta. We do not guarantee uninterrupted service, and the content may contain errors. If you spot a language error or bug, tell us — fast feedback is one of the points of running a beta.
terms.liability_p: To the extent allowed by law, Tomodachi is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the service. Our direct liability is limited to the amount you have paid us in the previous twelve months. During free beta, that amount is zero.
terms.changes_p: When we change these terms, we update the date at the top. Material changes are highlighted on the homepage for 30 days, and waitlist members receive a short email summary.
terms.governing_p: These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt. Disputes are resolved in Egyptian courts, except where mandatory consumer-protection law of your country of residence applies and is more protective of you.
terms.contact_p: Questions about these terms — reach us at betterme@bytepluslife.com. We aim to reply within seven days.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro_p: Tomodachi uses a small number of cookies and similar browser storage to keep you signed in and to remember your preferences. Optional cookies for analytics and error monitoring are loaded only after you accept them.
cookies.what_p: Cookies are small files stored by your browser. We also use localStorage, which is a related browser-side store. Where this policy says "cookies," it covers both unless we say otherwise.
cookies.essential_intro_p: These always load, with no consent prompt, because the app cannot function without them. They store nothing about advertising or tracking.
cookies.essential_li_auth: Firebase Auth session — keeps you signed in. Lives in localStorage and is cleared when you sign out or clear browser data.
cookies.essential_li_locale: tomodachi-lang — remembers your English or Arabic choice. localStorage, persistent.
cookies.essential_li_theme: tomodachi-theme — remembers your light or dark theme choice. localStorage, persistent.
cookies.essential_li_consent: tomodachi-consent — remembers your cookie-consent choices, so we do not re-ask on every visit. localStorage, persistent.
cookies.analytics_p: Loaded only when you accept the Analytics category in the consent banner. We use Google Analytics 4, which sets cookies named _ga and _ga_* (one per measurement ID). These count unique visitors and sessions, with IP anonymization where supported. The data lives in Google for 14 months, the GA4 default.
cookies.error_p: Loaded only when you accept the Error Monitoring category. We use Sentry, which sets a short-lived session identifier so related error reports can be grouped. Error reports are retained for 90 days.
cookies.control_p: The consent banner appears on your first visit. You can change your choice at any time using the Cookie Settings link in the footer of any page. Your browser also offers controls: you can clear cookies, block them by site, or enable Do Not Track. Tomodachi honors a "reject non-essential" decision regardless of how you express it.
cookies.third_p: Analytics cookies are set by Google. Error-monitoring cookies are set by Sentry. Tomodachi does not run advertising cookies and does not share cookie data with advertisers.
cookies.changes_p: When we add, remove, or change a cookie, we update this page and the date at the top. Material changes are highlighted on the homepage for 30 days.
cookies.contact_p: Questions about cookies — reach us at betterme@bytepluslife.com. For the broader picture of what data we collect, see the Privacy Policy linked from the homepage footer.

consent.title: Cookie preferences
consent.body: Tomodachi uses essential cookies to run the app. Optional analytics and error-context cookies help us improve — your call.
consent.modal_subtitle: Choose which categories to allow. You can change this any time from Settings.
consent.essential_desc: Required for sign-in and core app features. Cannot be disabled.
consent.analytics_desc: Helps us understand which features get used. Aggregated, never sold.
consent.error_desc: Captures error reports with your account info attached, so we can debug faster. Errors are still captured without it, just anonymously.

launch.question: When is Tomodachi launching?
launch.answer: Tomodachi does not have a fixed launch date yet. We are holding release until the learning experience and Arabic quality meet the bar, and waitlist members will be invited to the closed beta first.

free.question: Is it free?
free.answer: The first beta wave will be free. Later, Tomodachi will add a Pro tier for power-user features, while the free experience stays substantial.

mobile.question: Will there be a mobile app?
mobile.answer: Tomodachi already works on mobile in the browser, and it supports home-screen installation as a PWA. Native iOS and Android apps are on the roadmap, but they are not the first release target.

arabic_first.question: Why Arabic-first?
arabic_first.answer: Most Japanese-learning apps start in English and treat Arabic as a later layer. Tomodachi authors Arabic pedagogy natively — explanations written by people thinking in Arabic — so grammar, memory cues, and examples feel closer to the learner.

levels.question: What Japanese levels will be covered?
levels.answer: Tomodachi starts with JLPT N5: kana, about 800 vocabulary items, about 100 kanji, and N5 grammar. N4 follows after that, while N3 and beyond remain roadmap items, not promises.

data.question: How is my data handled?
data.answer: We store the minimum needed to run the product: email, display name, and game results. We do not sell data, the full privacy policy lives at /privacy, and deleting your account from Settings removes everything.

pro_cost.question: What will Pro cost?
pro_cost.answer: Final pricing is not set. We are planning regional pricing around $2/month equivalent for Egypt, roughly 70 EGP, and around $4/month equivalent for Gulf countries, with affordability as the main goal.
